quality.review_scope: The author and independent auditor each completed full text and original-page visual reading of all seven eligible main and ten eligible SI pages. Polymer controls, precursor preparations, five NC systems, solvent substitutions, purification/ligand exchanges and measurement contexts were independently audited within this scope; external cited methods remain outside scope. Formal complete-paper Reader is not claimed.
missing_fields: Eligible main seven and SI ten pages were read completely as text and original-page images; cited external methods are not imported.
Quantified modifications, supporting methods, controls and observations remain distinct. No physical batch identity is inferred from material-family names.
TEM scale bars are not particle diameters. No curve digitization, atomistic NC model, polymer chain length or unreported apparatus geometry is reconstructed.
Absolute NC amount, measured ligand total, ligand-stock aliquot, solvent volumes and centrifugation parameters remain unreported.
